envelope.description: Wire the DebugPane into the app.tsx switcher (5->6 panes)

body.title: Wire the DebugPane into the app.tsx switcher (5->6 panes)
body.summary: In src/cli/app.tsx: import DebugPane; append 'Debug' to the TABS tuple (:33); widen the numeric keybind guard from `input <= '5'` to `input <= '6'` (:126); add `{pane === 5 && <DebugPane services={services} />}` to the render fragment (:142-146); and update the two literal '1-5' key-hint strings (the '?' toast :130 and the KeyHints array :152) to '1-6'. Tab/Shift-Tab cycling already keys off TABS.length so it is unchanged. Build note (s3 critique): land t4 together-with t5 in one increment so the tui.test.ts suite compiles at every committed step.
acceptanceChecks: The numeric guard accepts '6' and selects pane index 5
The render fragment mounts DebugPane at pane === 5 passing the debug facade
Existing panes (indices 0-4), their keybindings, and Tab cycling are unchanged

tests.name: tui.test.ts: App renders a 6th '6:Debug' peer tab in the tab bar
tui.test.ts: pressing '6' selects the Debug pane and renders DebugPane; the previously active pane is hidden
tui.test.ts: Tab-cycling from the last existing pane reaches Debug (TABS.length-driven wrap)
